cross_validation.selection_rationale: The 3-fold, one-validation-sample-per-repository configuration retains all 22 repositories, preserves both classes in every fold, provides 6 to 7 positive validation observations per fold, and has zero future-target-window overlap violations.

primary_target_definition.description: The next four weeks receive at least 1.5 times as many stars as the previous four weeks.

secondary_target_definition.description: The next four-week star total is at or above the 80th percentile of the primary training period.

target_feature_ablation.reason: This historical feature is used in the relative-growth target definition. An ablation will verify that performance is not dependent only on this feature.

leakage_controls: Targets are created from future four-week outcomes.
All predictors are observed at or before the cutoff week.
The absolute target threshold is derived only from training data.
Train, validation, and test use purged temporal repository-aware forecasting splits.
The test target distribution is not summarized during development.
